purpose: Teach: 宿舎/華麗/赤外線/右脳/速記/接着/解像度/諸島

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが学生時代の宿舎の思い出を語って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to tell you about his student dormitory days.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Soft opening. Patient pacing. The tone of a mother setting up a small gift for her son to receive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りで華麗な踊りを見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the most beautiful dancers at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick breath-catch at the start. Rising energy, eager to share. The guileless enthusiasm of a six-year-old who's bursting with something good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが赤外線リモコンの仕組みを教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is going to explain how infrared remote controls work.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Gentle pacing. The slight wonder in her voice at what captures a child's attention. A mother observing and facilitating.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと右脳の絵あてゲームしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I played this picture-guessing game using the right side of our brains.
lines.style: Animated, quick delivery. Bright consonants. The simple pride of a child reporting something he did with his father. Not performed — genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが速記の見本を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is going to show you some shorthand samples.
lines.style: Calm, attentive. Slightly slower pace. A mother noting something her son might find interesting. Warm without overselling it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと接着剤で工作したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I made something with glue today!
lines.style: Energetic, immediate. Breathy excitement on the opening word. Quick sentences. The unselfconscious joy of a young child sharing a small craft project.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが高解像度の写真をプリントして下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is printing out some high-resolution photographs for you.
lines.style: Warm, purposeful. Gentle introduction. Steady pacing. The patient voice of a mother sharing another small thing her son's father is preparing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと諸島の地図を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, we looked at a map of all the islands together!
lines.style: Warm, satisfied contentment. Soft closing energy. A child settling into the comfort of having shared something with his parent. The slight trailing-off of a good memory.
